title: refactor(ui-types): one source for the filter-builder field-type list; close the three K4 review should-fixes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao93rRemsb94HTBb9ZVJHChk)_

Fixes #27369

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：filter-builder 的 14 种字段类型现在只在 `@object-ui/types` 的 `filter-field-types.ts` 声明一次，校验 schema、TS 接口、渲染器三处都从这里取；顺带处理 K4 评审的三条建议改项。
- 为什么改：以前三处手抄列表互相漂移（objectui#6939、#7562、#8774 修的都是这个），K4 之后还多了一份冻结列表。
- 风险与回滚：可接受的类型集合不变（仍 14 个，`type` 可选，缺省 `text`）；渲染行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/types/src/filter-field-types.ts`、`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx` 的分组导入、`ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` 新增的 skills 扫描行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.ts examples/schema-catalog/test/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.tsx`，预期全绿。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触及 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`（Tier H），待分诊合约复审后由你合并。

## What changes

**One source for the field-type list (card items 1–2).**

- New `ui/packages/types/src/filter-field-types.ts` declares the renderer's four behaviour buckets (`FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES`, `FILTER_DATE_LIKE_TYPES`, `FILTER_SELECT_LIKE_TYPES`, `FILTER_LOOKUP_LIKE_TYPES`) and `FILTER_FIELD_TYPES` (`text`, the buckets, `boolean`, in the order the retired doc used), plus the member type `FilterFieldType`. All are exported from `@object-ui/types`.
- `FilterFieldSchema.type` is `z.enum(FILTER_FIELD_TYPES).optional()`. Its `.describe()` no longer cites "the published doc", and its docblock says where the authority lives now.
- `FilterField['type']` is `FilterFieldType`, not a restated union.
- `filter-builder.tsx` imports the four buckets and declares no list of its own. They are rebound as `readonly string[]` locals so the existing `.includes(authoredType)` call sites compile unchanged.
- The validator half of `filter-builder-mirror-6939` drops `LAST_PUBLISHED_TYPES` and its doc-reader leftovers. It now pins: the enum equals `FILTER_FIELD_TYPES` member for member; every member is a spec `FieldType` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`) except `SPEC_FIELD_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS`, which names `status` with its one-line reason; every exemption is still live (in the list, still outside the spec); and the seven bucketed members are each carried by their shared bucket, which the renderer imports. The header's objectstack#27145 section is rewritten to say the authority is `FILTER_FIELD_TYPES`.
- The render half (`examples/schema-catalog/test/filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.tsx`) replaces the stale hand-kept seven ("…and the mirror refuses it") with one case per member of `FILTER_FIELD_TYPES` except `text`. Each case uses the existing `oneRow` measurement and asserts that the member draws a control signature (inputs plus trigger count) different from a nonsense spelling. `text` is the fallthrough target by construction; its by-name branch stays pinned in the validator half.

**K4 should-fix (1): the skill doc URLs are now gated.** This took both halves. `check-skills-paths.mjs` judges only backtick paths, and it resolves `content/` against `ui/`, so it could not reach a site URL. I chose `check-doc-links.mjs` instead:

- `SCAN_ROOTS` gains `{ path: '../skills/objectui', rule: 'disk', diskRoot: '../skills/objectui' }`. The bundle is read on GitHub and by agents, so its relative hrefs are disk paths. It ships to customer projects as one directory, so the new per-row `diskRoot` makes the bundle itself the boundary a relative href must stay inside. The default boundary, this tree's root, sits below the bundle and would have rejected all 34 intra-bundle links.
- The two prose URLs (`app-composition.md:62`, `styling.md:318`) become markdown links. The gate already judges `objectstack.ai` links as site routes against `apps/docs`.
- The new row also surfaced one gate gap: `guides/schema-expressions.md` has a heading inside a blockquote (`> ### …`). Both renderers anchor that heading, but the gate's ATX scan did not see it, and the corpus test went red. The heading scan now strips blockquote markers first. A unit pin covers this, and the setext-count test counts blockquoted ATX headings.
- `check-skills-token-ratchet`: the Theming link cost `styling.md` 2 tokens. I paid them by deleting text in the same line ("the token list" became "tokens"). `app-composition.md` is 1 token lighter.

**K4 should-fix (2).** `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: the ui paths-filter comment said "four roots outside ui/" above a list of five globs. It now says "five paths outside ui/". This is a comment-only change.

**K4 should-fix (3).** `ui/AGENTS.md` rule #2 pointed at the retired `content/docs/guide/*.md`. It now names the matching page under `content/docs/frontend/`.

**Changeset:** `.changeset/27369-filter-builder-field-types.md`, `@object-ui/types` patch and `@object-ui/components` patch, with both declaration lines.

### Skill bundle readings (`skills/**` touched)

| | before | after |
|:---|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md` | 63 lines · 1079 tokens | 63 lines · 1078 tokens |
| `skills/objectui/rules/styling.md` | 320 lines · 2699 tokens | 320 lines · 2699 tokens |
| all `SKILL.md` in `skills/` | 4614 lines | 4614 lines |
| `skills/objectui/**/*.md` | 4825 lines | 4825 lines |

## Tests

All runs are on head `796bf3a3` or on its parent `7dc5d3f6`, which differs only in `styling.md`.

- Card acceptance: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/types examples/schema-catalog` passed, with Test Files 429/429 and Tests 12850/12850.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts`: 123/123. The whole `scripts/` suite also ran as part of the derived gates (exit 0).
- Type-check UI: `@object-ui/types` `type-check` (src, examples and tests programs), `@object-ui/components` `type-check` and `@object-ui/example-schema-catalog` `type-check` all exit 0, built against a fresh build of their dependency closure.
- The four `components-complex-filter-builder/*` catalog entries and the nested `search-interface` builder still validate (`the catalog entries the mirror refused` describe, green).
- `git grep -n "LAST_PUBLISHED_TYPES\|published doc's fourteen"` prints nothing.

<details><summary>One-time ablations (each restored from HEAD; git status clean after each)</summary>

ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/types` to `src` through its alias, so these needed no dist rebuild.

1. **A fifteenth member with no renderer branch.** I added `'email'` to `FILTER_FIELD_TYPES` only. The render half went red on `` `email` draws a branch of its own, not the fallthrough `` (1 failed, 99 passed). The spec check stayed green, as it should, because `email` is a spec `FieldType`.
2. **A fifteenth member outside the spec.** I added `'zz_not_spec'` to `FILTER_SELECT_LIKE_TYPES`. The validator half went red on `every member is a spec FieldType, or a named exemption` (1 failed, 48 passed).
3. **Removing a member from a bucket narrows all three faces together.** I dropped `rating` from `FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES`:
   - **Schema:** `accepts rating, and the renderer draws it from the shared bucket FILTER_NUMBER_LIKE_TYPES` went red.
   - **Interface:** a scratch `const f: FilterField = { …, type: 'rating' }` failed `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` with TS2322. The control, run before the mutation, showed 0 errors.
   - **Renderer:** with `rating` forced into the render probe, `` `rating` draws a branch of its own `` went red. A `rating` column now draws the fallthrough.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `status` is the one member that is not a spec `FieldType`. It is exempted by name, not dropped, so the accepted set does not narrow.
- `check-doc-links` gained a row field (`diskRoot`) and a heading-scan fix. Both are inside the claim's "only if item 3 needs them" surface: the row is what gates the URLs, and the heading fix is what the row needed to land green.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates: 88 derived, 87 run, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 88 commands. I ran all of them on `7dc5d3f6` and reran the one red family after the fix:

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 1 on `7dc5d3f6` (`styling.md` 2701/2699), then exit 0 on `796bf3a3`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`: exit 3 until `client-react` was built, then exit 0 (270 prose examples type-check).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET because it needs every published package's dist. **NOT MEASURED** locally. The diff touches no package it loads, and CI runs it.
- The other 85 exited 0.

Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates --ran` printed `88 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 87 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`. Lint UI: `pnpm --dir ui run lint:root` reported 0 errors, and `turbo run lint` over the three touched ui packages reported 0 errors. Neither reported a warning on a changed line.

</details>

Tier H by path (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`). It stays a draft until green, then the triage seat writes the contract review and the maintainer merges.
